old_description: Since 2009, Mainstream Green has been veteran owned and operated, providing our customers with quality, reliable systems designed to last.  Our founding team all obtained Sharp Solar Certification in 2009, and Ernie obtained NABCEP PV Installation Professional Certification in 2012.  We've been learning and growing ever since.  We attained Sol-Ark "Gold" Installer status in 2023.  Sol-Ark offers the best solution we've found in 15+ years for the average person to be able to achieve some level of "Personal energy independence" using solar power.  A growing number of our Sol-Ark installs are 100% off-grid.   Our team has worked with families, farmers, and businesses across West Tennessee to reduce their electricity costs and become more energy independent.  We've also provided some of these clients with an optional whole-home backup power system, where everything stays on when the power goes off. If you have an older system under TVA's expired 10 year premium programs, we can convert it to a home back-up energy reducing system.   If we install it, we will service it.
about:
Mainstream Green Solutions LLC was founded in 2009 in Wildersville, Tennessee, by navy veteran Ernie Williams. The veteran-owned company began when Williams obtained Sharp Solar Certification and launched the business as a side venture while researching proven solar technologies. In 2012, he added NABCEP PV Installation Professional certification, and the firm transitioned to full-time operation after 13 years.

The company designs, installs, and services photovoltaic and battery storage systems for residential, agricultural, and commercial clients across West Tennessee. Services include system design and engineering, energy consulting, PV system maintenance, EMP protection, and conversion of legacy TVA grid-tie installations to self-consumption with battery backup. Projects range from off-grid tiny homes and mobile hybrid campground power stations to a solar farm in Gibson County and whole-home backup systems starting under $10,000 installed.

Customers include families, farmers, and businesses such as a medical clinic that received a custom installation. The firm also assists rural businesses and farms in securing USDA REAP grants, which can cover up to 50% of system costs for 2024–2025. All installations use equipment from manufacturers like Sol-Ark, for which Mainstream Green holds Gold Installer status.

Williams emphasizes honest, data-driven proposals and a commitment to service: “If we install it, we will service it.” The company avoids chasing technology trends, instead relying on proven components and transparent cost analysis tailored to each client’s unique situation.
